verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships meeting transcription/summarization (docs-3, docs-10, docs-13) and community reports confirm TTS/STT model support (comm-3), suggesting speech-to-text and text-to-speech capability exist. However, there's no evidence of live two-way voice conversation or a dedicated 'voice note' chat feature akin to a messaging surface. Missing for 10: documented live voice conversation mode, evidence of spoken replies in normal chat (not just meeting summaries), and independent hands-on confirmation of voice note transcription in the chat UI.
